subject: Logic
title: The Continuum Hypothesis
description: Learn The Continuum Hypothesis in one minute.

hook.text: Cantor showed some infinities are bigger than others. But is there an infinity in between the two he found?

buildup.text: The continuum hypothesis asks: is there a set bigger than the integers but smaller than the real numbers?

discovery.text: Cantor couldn't prove or disprove it. He obsessed over it until he suffered a mental breakdown.

twist.text: In 1963, Paul Cohen proved the hypothesis is independent—it can be neither proved nor disproved from standard axioms.

climax.text: Some questions in mathematics have no answer—not because we're ignorant, but because the rules don't decide.

punchline.text: A question math itself cannot settle.

quiz.question: What is the status of the continuum hypothesis?
options: It is independent of standard axioms
